[SWS_DM_01061] Trigger all scheduled
PDIDs
per scheduler
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04215
⌈
When a periodic scheduler elapses for a requested transmission rate, the DM shall
trigger the transmission of all scheduled
PDIDs
assigned to this transmission rate.
⌋
